activity.title: Keep a stone warm in a box
materials: a steel box with a lid
steps: Hold the stone in your hands for two minutes so that it feels a little warm.
Put the warm stone in the steel box and wrap the closed box in the towel.
Put the bottle of water beside it, not wrapped.
After ten minutes, touch the stone and the bottle and say which one feels warmer.
activity.observe: The wrapped stone stays warmer than the bottle left in the open. Notice what the towel did.
safety: No hot water, no flame and no electric heater.
An adult stays with the child.
listenFor: says the covered box keeps the warmth in
